title: Caption over a hero image
summary: An absolute caption with inset: auto 0 0 0 sits across the bottom of a fixed-height image box.
explanation: The hero is a fixed-height box with position: relative and overflow: hidden. The image fills it and any extra is clipped, so the box never grows with its content.
The caption is absolute with inset: auto 0 0 0: no top offset, and zero offsets on the right, bottom and left. It stretches across the full width and sits on the bottom edge, over the image.
tryThis: Remove overflow: hidden from .hero and make the caption text longer: the text can spill out the bottom.
Change inset to 0 0 0 0: the caption now covers the whole image.
Change the height of .hero to 120px and see the caption stay pinned to the bottom.
